versions.content: If the configuration parameter LinSMConfirmationTimeout is set to zero the timer is not used, and hence a timeout cannot occur. This means that requirements [SWS_LinSM_00102], [SWS_LinSM_00170] and [SWS_LinSM_00215] will not happen.
